note: v469: Fixes the bulk-edit bar from v468. It was stuck on screen on every page (including Customers, where nothing is selectable — so Edit did nothing); it now only appears on Expenses/Invoices after you tap Select, and disappears when you're done. Also restyled it to match the app (frosted pill, clear All / Edit / delete / Done buttons instead of cryptic icons), and tapping a row no longer flickers or jumps the list.
